def check_constraint(N, K):
    """
    Checks if the coloring C(i, j) = (i+j) mod K satisfies the constraint 
    in every 2x2 subgrid on an N x N grid.
    """
    for i in range(N - 1):
        for j in range(N - 1):
            colors = [
                (i + j) % K,
                (i + 1 + j) % K,
                (i + j + 1) % K,
                (i + 1 + j + 1) % K
            ]
            # Check if all four colors are distinct
            if len(set(colors)) == 4:
                return False, colors
    return True, None
